activity_summary: At dinner you were upright, and that was the whole report of Tuesday night. You did not give the house a name or a king. The loaf was two fingers short of the notch, and the price was a penny. Alse did not ask again whether the one who dies is a boy. Mistress Ansell did not collect a guest to set beside the notch.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the second half of the report.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Measured the loaf, and did not collect a king.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Left Sunday's answer where it was.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Kept the kitchen clear of the close's story.

facets.activity: Ate dinner and kept the parlour to himself

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: You are upright. That is as much as I require of a Tuesday night.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The loaf is short of the notch by two fingers, and the price is a penny.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Upright is the report, Mistress. There is no second half of it.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: I will not ask if the one who dies is still a boy.
